content:
oliver_sre: Heads-up: We're running a dry-run eviction + rebalance on a small subset of edge kvcache tonight 2026-04-15 00:30-01:30 UTC. Purpose: validate stage gates and rewarm scripts without full purge.
maya_oncall: Acknowledge. Which racks are in the subset?
oliver_sre: Canary set = us-east-1a (labels: region=us-east,group=kv-dryrun). ~5% traffic. No customer-impacting purge; this will only simulate eviction plan and run rewarm probes.
jack_eng: I'll start a synthetic traffic generator that hits cache-miss paths to emulate rehydration. Will cap at 50 qps per AZ.
tara_prod: Product: we'll hold customer comms unless we see >10% p95 increase for 20m in Dedicated tenants. Notify support if that happens.
deploy_bot: Event created: "kv-dryrun-eviction-rebalance" 2026-04-15T00:30Z by oliver_sre.
maya_oncall: Runbook highlights: 1) enable canary: `POST /ops/route-shift {"policy":"kv-dryrun","percent":5}` 2) start synthetic rewarm: `infra/tools/synth_rewarm --canary --qps 50` 3) observe metrics edge.kvcache.hit_ratio, infer.latency_p95, route_error_rate for 15m.
oliver_sre: Rollback is simple: set percent to 0 and stop synth rewarm: `POST /ops/route-shift {"policy":"kv-dryrun","percent":0}` and `pkill -f synth_rewarm`.
jack_eng: I'll stream logs to the runbook notebook and tag events with tags: dryrun, canary, synth.
maya_oncall: I'll be watching dashboards and will post a short summary in this thread at +20m and at completion.
oliver_sre: Thanks 97 aim is to validate zero-customer impact. If anyone wants to shadow the canary ping me before 00:15 UTC.
